quandoUsar: A fixed plan quota, such as storage, seats, or credits, when it matters to see what takes up the space and how much remains until the limit.
Warn before the limit: from `warnAt` (default 90%) the badge shows “Almost full”, and above the limit the excess portion appears hatched, with a marker at the limit.
Plan and billing screens where the user explores the categories by hovering, tapping, or using the arrow keys in the legend.
quandoEvitar: Use `progress` for a single progress measure, without categories or a plan limit.
Use `composition-chart` or `donut-chart` for the breakdown of a whole with no limit, or with more than four parts.
Use `gauge` for a single value within a known range.

teclado.acao: The legend is a single `Tab` stop (roving tabindex); focus already highlights the category in the bar and in the big number.
Move focus between the categories and the free-space item, wrapping around.
Moves to the first category or to the free-space (or excess) item.
Pins the highlight on the focused category (`aria-pressed`); again, unpins.

acessibilidade: The bar is `role="img"` with a full summary in `aria-label` (total, each category, and free space); the spinning numbers are `aria-hidden` and there is a hidden text with the total.
The legend is a group of buttons with roving tabindex and `aria-pressed`; a live region only speaks when the state changes (normal, almost full, over the limit) or the excess changes.
Above the limit, the excess is hatched as well as colored and the badge gains an icon, so the state does not depend on color alone.
movimento: The first time it appears on screen, the segments grow from left to right, one after another; afterward, each change makes them all slide with a no-overshoot spring.
The numbers spin like an odometer in the direction of the change, the badge adjusts its width with a spring, and highlighting a category dims the others.
With “reduce motion”, values and widths change immediately and the texts only fade.
responsivo: The legend is an `auto-fit` grid with columns of at least 108 px, which becomes more rows in a narrow card; a long title wraps next to the badge.
desempenho: It waits for 40% of the meter to enter the screen before animating and watches the bar's width with a `ResizeObserver`; the segment positions come from motion values, with no per-frame re-render.
notasIA: Import from `@/components/ryan-ui/usage-meter/usage-meter`. Pass `segments` with a stable `id` (changing the value keeps the segment and animates), `limit` in the same unit, and `unit`, such as `"GB"`.
Use at most four segments: the CSS only defines colors for four, and a fifth has no color in the bar and the legend.

Numbers come out in en-US format (decimal point) and the texts (“of 50 GB used”, “Almost full”) are in English; `freeLabel` and `overLabel` translate only part, the rest is adjusted in the copied file.
